newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asiamatrix sees proposed takeover offer.
newsitem.headline: Asiamatrix sees proposed takeover offer.

text.p: A private company registered in the British Virgin Islands leads a proposal on Friday to buy a majority stake in plastic injection maker Asiamatrix Ltd.
The takeover bid from Silver Beads International Ltd will involve sale shares representing approximately 50.98 percent of AsiaMatrix's share capital, OUB Bank said in a statement.
Silver Beads will buy 13.46 million shares at Singapore $0.50 each in the capital of Asiamatrix with Billiontex International Ltd, Lim Cheok Peng, Djeng Shih Kien and Dominic Er Kong Kiong.
The shares will be purchased at a cash price of S$1.45 each.
It said that prior to the acquisition of the shares, the buyers owned a total of 346,000 shares of S$0.50 each which represented 1.31 percent of Asiamatrix's share capital.
The purchase is expected to be completed on July 21, provided the suspension of trading in Asiamatrix shares has been lifted.
Asiamatrix requested for a suspension of trade in its shares with immediate effect on June 27.
OUB, financial adviser to the purchasers, said they will make an offer to acquire the remaining 12.6 million shares of S$0.50 at S$1.45 for each offer share.
